pages.text: Knuckledusters are weapons that inflict a relatively low amount of damage but in return are much faster to use. Additionally, they enable the user to easily perform a 'lunge' into the direction they are looking, which can be useful for both offense - to enter close combat - and defense - to retreat in haste.

The Toothknocker can be crafted with Teeth, a Crystallized Bond and plenty of Gluttonous Scales. To bring out its full potential, one has to be held in each hand; then every attack will shatter teeth.
The Stripper is unfit for damage output and instead shines in its utility. With every attack, it has a chance to strip away the armor of the enemy monster or to steal an item off the attacked person.
